name: Aiptasia pallida
relation_curated: new combination in *Exaiptasia*, then junior subjective synonym of *E. diaphana*
act_evidence: WoRMS unaccept reason: new genus created by Grajales & Rodriguez 2014 (the genus step). The synonymy with diaphana is a taxonomic judgement; Opinion 2404 (2017) declined to give pallida precedence over diaphana and Opinion 2500 (2023) declined to reverse it. They fix the name only if the two are conspecific. The article uses a worldwide sensu lato concept (source p. 17).
unaccept_reason: new genus created by Grajales & Rodriguez 2014
act_sources: unaccept reason: new genus created by Grajales & Rodriguez 2014

name: Anthopleura cascaia

name: Exaiptasia pallida
relation_curated: junior subjective synonym of *E. diaphana*; precedence of *diaphana* upheld
act_evidence: WoRMS record (modified 2020-12-16) still reads 'pallida valid until ICZN rules Case 3790', which predates Opinion 2500 (2023); the record is stale. In February 2016 Case 3633 was pending.
unaccept_reason: subjective synonym; epithet diaphana retains priority over pallida (ICZN Opinion 2404). However, epithet pallida valid until ICZN rules Case 3790 (revision of Opinion 2404)
act_sources: source of synonymy: ICZN (2017) | new combination reference: Grajales, A.; Rodríguez, E (2014)
